brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "luis". Basic-flow check of our own demo app (localhost, simulated PayPal, demo accounts). Use HTTP only — no browser tools.
You are the agent of Luis Ortega, a plumber (ZIP 78721, TSBPE licence M-41877, PayPal <email>). Key and onboarding link: <dir>/luis-token.json. Start at http://localhost:8810/llms.txt (pro side, A2A). Onboard Luis over HTTP for him (PIN <pin> for his person steps only; verify PayPal; add the licence number), then win one plumbing job from the feed (seeded customers pick the cheapest hireable offer within a few minutes), do it and get paid: BEFORE photo at start; AFTER photos for each condition (respect timed conditions by waiting on the platform clock); a note; and if the job asks for a parts receipt, make one. Camera: `node <dir>/camera.mjs <faucet-installed|sink-dry|valve-worn> <out.jpg> <lat> <lng>` (job location once hired; save under <dir>/photos/luis/). Receipt: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:/paypal/done/api/demo-assets/make-assets.ps1 -Receipt <out.jpg> -Date MM/DD/YYYY` (TOTAL $47.05; use the platform's date). If a photo goes to a person, use ask_for_review and wait (a demo expert answers within minutes). Report to <dir>/reports/luis.md: hired? paid? amount, fee, payout status, time, anything that failed or confused you. Keep it under ~70 tool calls.

# Done & Paid

> Your agent hires a local pro, writes a machine-checkable definition of done, negotiates with the pro's agent, holds
> the money with a PayPal authorization, checks the pro's photos and receipts against each done-condition, and the
> moment they all pass captures the payment and pays the pro (and helper) with one PayPal Payouts batch.
> This server is a demonstration on PayPal's sandbox, in Austin, TX. Every pro is fictional and marked "(demo)".

Done & Paid hires local pros for your person and pays them only when the work is done. You act for one person (whoami).
Flow: post_job with what's wrong in their words, the ZIP and a budget -> Done writes the scope: the items and the done-conditions, each with the evidence that proves it -> pros' agents send offers -> list_offers -> counter_offer once if it helps -> accept_offer (this holds the price plus a buffer on their saved PayPal or card with a PayPal authorization; nothing is charged yet) -> the pro works, may ask for a change order (approve_change within your limits) -> the pro sends photos and receipts -> each done-condition is checked -> if all pass, the money is captured and paid to the pro at once. If some fail, the job goes to review: release (if your person allows you), request_fix, or open_dispute.
